name: Magic of Lights Daytona
address: 1801 W International Speedway Blvd, Daytona Beach, FL 32114
cost: From $33.99 per vehicle; $20 per vehicle for November visits
paras: Magic of Lights Daytona is a drive-through holiday light show at Daytona International Speedway. The host lists a season from November 20, 2026 to January 2, 2027, with the lights on nightly from 6 PM to 10 PM.

Tickets are sold per vehicle. The host lists a standard car weekday ticket at $33.99 and an any-day ticket at $36.99, with a $20 per vehicle price for November visits. Gate prices run a few dollars higher, and a limo or party bus pays more. Tickets are sold through Tixr.
tip: Buy tickets online, since the host lists gate prices a few dollars higher.

name: Holly Hill Christmas Tree Lighting
paras: The 67th Annual Holly Hill Christmas Tree Lighting takes place on Friday, December 4, from 6 PM to 7 PM on the front steps of City Hall. The listing promises festive performances and a visit from Santa Claus.
The event is free and open to all. It comes the day before the Holly Hill Christmas Parade on December 5, which makes it an easy kickoff to the town's holiday weekend.
tip: The tree lighting is the evening before the parade, so you can do both.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Azure Oceanfront Dining
venue: Azure Oceanfront Dining at The Shores Resort and Spa
address: The Shores Resort and Spa, Daytona Beach Shores, FL
when_note: Breakfast buffet 7 to 11 AM; Santa visits 9:30 to 11:30 AM
cost: $24.99 per adult; $12.99 for children 12 and under
paras: Azure Oceanfront Dining at The Shores Resort and Spa hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 5. The buffet runs 7 AM to 11 AM and Santa's visit is listed for 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM.
The host prices the buffet at $24.99 per adult and $12.99 for children 12 and under. The page mentions ocean views and photos with Santa, and offers a Reserve Now link through OpenTable.
tip: Santa starts at 9:30 AM, so arrive after that for the best chance of a photo.

name: S.T.R.E.A.M.: Holiday Ornaments
paras: Volusia County Public Library lists S.T.R.E.A.M.: Holiday Ornaments on Monday, December 14, from 3 PM to 4:30 PM in the Hope Place Library meeting room, for school age children.
Kids learn about the melting points of crayons and plastic while they design and make crayon speckled ornaments. The listing says supplies may be limited and that no registration is required.
tip: Supplies may be limited, so arrive early.

name: Spotlight: LaunchPad Holiday Extravaganza
address: 105 Jackie Robinson Parkway, Daytona Beach, FL
paras: The Daytona Beach Regional Library LaunchPad hosts a holiday themed program on Monday, December 14, from 2 PM to 4 PM. The audience is listed as all ages.
Visitors take part in activities, games and craft making using LaunchPad equipment and materials. The listing says no registration is required.
tip: No registration is needed, so you can drop in during the two hour window.
